description.value: BLAH (Benjamin Lumb Art House) is an art gallery in North Vancouver operated by artist Benjamin Lumb, situated on Marine Drive. The acronymic name reflects the kind of self-aware wit common to independent artist-run spaces. Touring cyclists riding the Marine Drive corridor would find this a compact cultural stop worth a visit.
